Npm receives121 observations (1175seconds scheduled waits plus request time); other publication boundaries retain6. Publication is still performed once before observation. CI-only preparation removes only its current version tag inside the disposable inner build clone so the full integrity checks can validate already-published source. Actual release preparation still rejects conflicting tags and CI-only candidates remain ineligible for publication. Source/published refs remain intact. Sanitized filesystem errors now retain numeric errno without disclosing paths.

The failed hosted run34472985590 at2b0a488a reported a generic OSError. Local reproduction with its source and real publishedv1.0.0 on Python3.12.3 and3.11.15 established local-tag conflict, but does not establish that conflict as the only original hosted cause. The replacement hosted run must be observed separately; this assessment establishes local readiness to submit the correction, not hosted success.

Evidence ci-repair-proof records identical failed-before/passed-after tests and34 passing focused tests. Original bugfix-proof still covers unchanged polling implementation; fresh reviewer independently reran its last-poll regression alongside tagged-CI and error-redaction cases (3 tests passed6.858s). Review r2 approves all7 engineering files with no findings; its full-suite-pending limitation is resolved by ci-repair-pr-checks. The actual prepared commit was e274555d66e4820e62ccb32592c5ce3f4249e1eb; candidate b74aa4056a161ce3deda67d43d0a2f54b8faa3f31f945fd992bfbfdaf7799eb5. This uses the real candidate builder, release integrity, broad smoke and selected PR checks, not a mocked full verifier. Also ran `node scripts/validate-record-store.mjs docs/changes/2026-09-10-npm-publication-visibility/change.json` and `git diff --check`, both passed. Final supporting changes are attributable evidence/review/routing only and do not alter tested engineering subjects or applicable environment.

Affected surfaces are bounded post-publication observation, CI preparation in temporary clones, redacted diagnostics, regressions and operator guidance. Packaging/build interactions are directly proved by the full candidate run. Inspected diff changes no dependency, package API, schema, release permission, authentication, actual publication command, operational recovery state or historical published metadata. No existing protective check is removed. Existing source tag remains8525fa94083597d010b6250cc114ca3f90a142e5. No live release, external write retry or twenty-minute sleep is represented by fixture proof. Observation may still exhaust; its truthful incomplete outcome and safe recovery remain. No blockers, findings or planned implementation milestones remain. Prior r1 and prior Verify retain their original meaning; r2 and this report supply renewed applicability for the expanded correction. Revert the scoped code if needed; no published artifact rollback is needed.
